mechanism: Both drugs can cause hypotension and renal impairment; zoledronic acid may potentiate the antihypertensive effects of telmisartan and increase risk of acute kidney injury, particularly in volume-depleted patients.
action: Monitor blood pressure and renal function (creatinine, eGFR) before and after zoledronic acid infusion; ensure adequate hydration; consider dose adjustment or timing separation if renal function declines.
